gradients: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,220,200,0.15), rgba(200,235,230,0.2)) /* media grid bg */
color.mood: Warm, institutional, dignified with soft pastoral mint accent. Clean and uncluttered.

weight_usage.400: Regular - default body text, button labels
weight_usage.700: Bold - headings, section titles, card titles

typography.special: Korean text uses mixed Avenir + Noto Sans KR. Staff names use spaced characters (letter-spacing).

layout.pattern: Full-width stacked sections, no visible max-width container

sections.name: header
sections.description: Fixed/pinned header with church logo left, UMH logo right. Minimal height, transparent over hero.

sections.name: hero-slider
sections.description: Full-viewport image carousel with dark semi-transparent overlay. Left/right nav arrows. 3 CTA buttons centered at bottom with white border.

sections.name: quick-links
sections.description: 4 equal worship service cards in a row. Each card has gradient background, service type label (English small caps), Korean title, and schedule time.

sections.name: banner
sections.description: Full-width mint/teal banner with single centered CTA button (기부금 영수증 발급).

sections.name: media-grid
sections.description: 3x3 grid of YouTube video thumbnails with titles below. Soft pink-to-mint gradient background.

sections.name: worship-info
sections.description: Two-column: left has 예배 안내 schedule table, right has church building photo + map. White background.

sections.name: departments
sections.description: 6 ministry department logos in a row + 3 affiliate organization logos below. White background.

sections.name: notices
sections.description: 4-column layout with text content: 훈련과 성숙, 전인적 교육, 교회 소식, event poster.

sections.name: staff
sections.description: Section title '섬기는 사람들'. Circular portrait photos in grid (4 columns). Each has name, title, role description. White/off-white background.

sections.name: anniversary-cta
sections.description: Light gray background. Large centered headline '65주년 기념 책 & 화보집' with mint-colored '다운받기' button.

sections.name: footer
sections.description: Minimal footer with church logo, two addresses (본관, 언더우드기념관), phone/fax numbers.

layout.max_width: No explicit container; content aligns within ~1200px center area
layout.whitespace_density: Generous. Clean sections with ample vertical spacing (40-80px between content blocks)
layout.section_flow: Vertical stack, full-width. Alternating white/colored backgrounds create visual rhythm.
sticky_elements: Social media sidebar (fixed right: YouTube, KakaoTalk, Instagram)

hover_patterns: CTA buttons: likely border/opacity change on hover
Staff cards: '자세히 보기' button appears on hover
Quick link cards: subtle hover scale
interaction.loading_style: Server-rendered Wix, lazy-loaded images and YouTube embeds
micro_interactions: Hero carousel arrows (< >) for manual slide control

brand_voice.tone: Warm, dignified, institutional. Church community warmth balanced with Presbyterian formality.
brand_voice.headline_pattern: Clean Korean headings. Section titles are short and direct (섬기는 사람들, 예배 안내). No decorative punctuation.
brand_voice.cta_style: Understated. White-bordered buttons on hero. Mint/teal accent for standalone CTAs. '자세히 보기' (View details) pattern for secondary actions.
brand_voice.copy_density: Low-to-medium. Visual-heavy with images and video thumbnails. Text content concentrated in notices section.
brand_voice.social_proof_style: Video thumbnails of sermons and worship. Staff section with formal portraits builds trust.
unique_vocabulary: 온라인 새가족 등록 (Online New Family Registration)
